title: Shaan Puri: 11 easy-for-me, valuable-for-you ways to give back to aging parents
summary: A personal essay where Shaan lists ways to give back to aging parents, ranked from low to high cost and effort, built on the idea of "easy for me, valuable for you" trades. It is mostly about family and mindset, with a few transferable ideas: trade low-value time for high-value relationships, give gifts people won't buy themselves, and capture irreplaceable moments. Little business content.

principles.text: The best trades are easy for you and valuable to the other person.
principles.quote: What are the simple, low cost, low effort things for me, that would make a big impact for them? Those are the best life trades: “Easy for me, valuable for you”

principles.text: Swap low-value time (scrolling) for high-value relationships; it's a hugely +EV trade.
principles.quote: Trading 10 minutes of social media for 10 minutes of facetime with your parents is possibly the highest +EV trade you can make.

principles.text: Share your work-in-progress; it costs no extra time and makes people feel included and proud.
principles.quote: This takes zero extra time, but makes them feel included & proud of you.

principles.text: Buy people the thing they need but would never buy themselves; frugality makes them commit once it's paid for.
principles.quote: She would have never bought this herself. She also wouldn't have agreed to it if I asked her. But I bought it, and if there's anything my mom refuses to do, it's waste money.

principles.text: Capture irreplaceable moments now, because you can't recreate them later.
principles.quote: it doesn't matter what she said - I just know that someday when she's gone, I'll be glad I did it so that I can hear her voice again.

principles.text: The thing people closest to you want most is for you to stop sabotaging yourself.
principles.quote: More than buying them stuff, or traveling, giving them grandkids or calling them – was just letting them be at peace because they know you're going in the right direction.
